newsitem.title: USA: Roberds says July sales showing improvement.
newsitem.headline: Roberds says July sales showing improvement.

text.p: Roberds Inc said Wednesday its outlook for the second half of 1997 is positive, assuming the retailing environment picks up.
Kenneth Fletcher, chairman, president and chief executive officer of Roberds said in a statement, "We are cautiously optomistic about the prospects for our business for the remainder of 1997."
He added, "Assuming the retail environment improves, we expect better financial results as we move through 1997."

The retailer reported a wider loss in the second quarter compared to last year, however, Fletcher said the early indications show the company's same store sales for the month of July begining to show improvement.
For the quarter, Roberds said it lost $1.3 million or $0.22 a share compared to a loss of $719,000 or $0.12 a share in the second quarter of 1996.
